module_summary: Programmable timeout timer for UART receiver; decrements and loads with configurable divisor.

anchors.name: tq
anchors.why: 19-bit timer countdown register; decremented each cycle or loaded with scaled divisor.

anchors.name: idle_o
anchors.why: Timer idle indicator: asserted when tq is zero (all bits clear).

anchors.name: div_i
anchors.why: 16-bit divisor input scaled by load multiplier to set timeout duration.

anchors.name: ld_long
anchors.why: Load long timeout: multiplies divisor by 8 and loads into timer.

anchors.name: ld_half
anchors.why: Load half timeout: multiplies divisor by 4 and loads into timer.

anchors.name: wide_div
anchors.why: Extended divisor: zero-padded to 19 bits for scaled load computation.

groups.name: Timer Counter
groups.description: Countdown timer and idle status output indicating timer expiration.

groups.name: Load Controller
groups.description: Selectable load multipliers (8x and 4x) applied to divisor input.

groups.name: Datapath
groups.description: Divisor extension and scaling for load value computation.
